Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Top-down timed lap driving on Nordic logging track 'Nimkaädel'. Objective: complete 8 checkpoints in one lap within unknown time limit. Lap timer (top-right) counts UP in elapsed seconds (~1s per action step); no countdown observed.

TRACK SECTIONS: (1) Logging yard with tarmac, billboards, log piles, orange fence. (2) Flooded/underwater forest with submerged trees, white dashed lane markers, blue stone obstacles, tan log piles, red cones. (3) Night forest with dark conifers, headlights required, scattered rocks. Nimkaädel teal gate is the start/finish landmark.

CONTROLS: W=throttle forward; S=brake (held engages reverse gear R); A/D=steer left/right; Space=handbrake; Return=confirm/advance black screens.

MECHANICS & OBSERVATIONS: (a) Black screens follow off-road collisions or end-of-section transitions. Return key (not wait or click) advances black screens reliably. (b) Checkpoint HUD shows dots: white/blue=completed, light/empty=remaining, all-red=off-track or critical damage state. (c) Speed builds incrementally with W presses; max ~44 mph observed. (d) Off-road/collision triggers respawn near Nimkaädel gate with penalty time. (e) Log piles trap vehicle between them at low speed; reverse+steer (S+A) extracts car. (f) Neutral gear (N) shown in HUD during stalled states; brief W tap shifts to forward. (g) Gear states: N=neutral (stationary), R=reverse (after S), forward (after W).

CURRENT LAP PROGRESS: Started at checkpoint 1/8 (06:04.745), advanced through flooded forest section, currently at 06:39.745 with checkpoint 1/8 completed. Speed 9 mph. No damage indicators visible. Vehicle responsive to throttle.

FAILED STRATEGIES: (a) Holding W straight through curves at high speed causes off-track crash. (b) Stopping at STOPPE banners produces no checkpoint registration. (c) Waiting or clicking during black screens does NOT advance state; only Return works. (d) Sustained steering at speed causes drifting off-road. (e) All-red checkpoint dots indicate off-track or failure state.

WORKING STRATEGY: Follow white dashed lane markers, maintain moderate speed (~5-25 mph in sections), use short steering taps for curves, throttle continuously (W) to progress between checkpoints.

UNCERTAINTY: Exact checkpoint locations/triggers (appear to be spatial zones), whether lap has time limit, precise damage threshold, meaning of all-red HUD dots (off-track indicator vs damage accumulation), whether lap timer can expire mid-play.
